options.name: cloud_api_key
options.description: Cloud API Key to authenticate with Grafana Cloud.

options.name: delete_protection
options.description: Enables or disables deletion protection for the Cloud stack. When set to true, the stack cannot be deleted unless this flag is explicitly disabled.

options.name: name
options.description: Sets the name of stack. Conventionally matches the URL of the instance. For example, C(stackslug.grafana.net).

options.name: org_slug
options.description: Name of the organization under which Cloud stack is created.

options.name: region
options.description: Sets the region for the Grafana Cloud stack.

options.name: stack_slug
options.description: Sets the subdomain of the Grafana instance. For example, if slug is B(stackslug), the instance URL will be C(https://stackslug.grafana.net).

options.name: state
options.description: State for the Grafana Cloud stack.

options.name: url
options.description: If you use a custom domain for the instance, you can provide it here. If not provided, Will be set to C(https://stackslug.grafana.net).
